text:
mona_cs: Quick flag 1 VerdantAI renewal in 4 weeks. Noticed a steep drop in calls (~84% down) and their platform lead left yesterday. They asked sales for a demo from BeaconML last week.
ops_bot: [ALERT] VerdantAI - Usage -84% (30d), Active seats: 5/48, Health: 26/100. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/verdantai/health
sam_csm: that's concerning. any infra issues showing?
ivy_ae: sales notes say Verdant requested a cost/latency comparison vs BeaconML. They also asked for logs export.
ezra_se: I checked their dedicated node traces. There's a recurring KV cache miss storm during batch windows leading to elevated p99. Filed TKT-22345.
nina_oncall: TKT-22345 owner acked. Proposed mitigation: kv-pin + smaller batch window, ETA 36h for canary.
mona_cs: timeline = champion exit + infra tail issues + competitor pilot. treat as "active" renewal at-risk.
sam_csm: proposed triage play: 1) 15-min check-in with interim tech owner 2) offer an immediate zero-cost 7-day latency bench on their real corpus 3) canary patch for TKT-22345 + before/after p99 graphs 4) offer 30 days of discounted capacity to keep momentum.
ivy_ae: I'll ask what Beacon demo covered and whether cost or features drove interest. Also confirm who is owning decisions now.
ezra_se: I'll prioritize a small canary and capture p50/p95/p99 across identical query mix. If the patch helps, we can include the config in the bench report.
mona_cs: owners: @ivy_ae outreach & competitor intel; @ezra_se infra fix & bench; @sam_csm lead renewal comms and credits ask.
ops_bot: [REMINDER] Follow up in 48h for customer response.
sam_csm: drafting outreach: "Noticed activity dropped and heard you're evaluating BeaconML. Can we run a short, no-cost latency benchmark on your dataset and share the config + cost delta? Also available for a 15-min health check to align next steps." Thoughts?
ivy_ae: good. add: "If useful, we'll share a 1-page exec summary that highlights unit economics and risk mitigation steps."
mona_cs: also prepare a short troubleshooting note we can send if they ask for immediate fixes (one-pager). Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/verdantai-triage (WIP).
ezra_se: small diagnostic SQL I ran: ```SELECT count(*) FROM api_calls WHERE account='verdantai' AND ts > now()-interval '30 days'; -- 34 (prev 210)```
nina_oncall: I'll watch the canary deployment and post results. If customer asks for credits above $5k, ping me and I'll loop pricing ops.
sam_csm: ok team, I'll ping Verdant now and update this thread with the response. Keep phones nearby. :thumbsup:
